propositions: Close gate falls through to LLM verifier when a bug closed as duplicate has no recorded replacement link, offering only impossible remedies instead of naming the required 'rebar link <id> <canonical> duplicates' command.
Hard fail must occur before any billable LLM call when duplicate close lacks a replacement/duplicates link, raising CommandError with the exact link command.
Duplicate close must require link EXISTENCE only, not target openness — a duplicate of an already-closed canonical must proceed to disposition verdict.
Duplicate class alone should hard-fail on missing link; not_a_bug and escalated must retain fallthrough behavior since neither owes a duplicates link.
Dead or archived replacement targets must produce a distinct error message from missing links, guiding operator to re-link to a live canonical.
